en.headline: Police say about 380,000 watched National Day fireworks
en.dek: Officers put the Victoria Harbour crowd at about 380,000 after the 23-minute display, above the earlier estimate of 260,000.
body: Police said about 380,000 people watched Thursday night's National Day fireworks from both sides of Victoria Harbour, according to reports citing the force after the display. Before the show, police had estimated about 260,000 spectators.

The display began at 8pm and lasted 23 minutes. The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau had said more than 30,000 pyrotechnic shells would be released. Ming Pao reported that patterns including sunflowers and a cosmos motif appeared over the harbour.

Crowds gathered along the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront and other harbour viewpoints. Special traffic arrangements and temporary closures of some MTR station exits had been in place before the show to manage the flow of people.
Chief Executive John Lee, quoted by RTHK, said more than 30,000 fireworks lit the harbour for 23 minutes. The display marked the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China.

zh.headline: 警方稱約38萬人觀賞國慶煙花匯演
zh.dek: 煙花匯演結束後，警方表示約有38萬人在維港兩岸觀賞，高於事前預估26萬人。
body: 國慶煙花匯演星期四晚在維多利亞港上空舉行。明報及香港電台引述警方表示，約有38萬人在維港兩岸觀賞。警方事前預計約26萬人到場。
匯演晚上8時開始，歷123分鐘。文化體育及旅遊局早前表示，會發放超過3萬枚煙花。明報報道，維港上空出現太陽花及宇宙圖案。
大批市民和旅客聚集尖沙咀海傍等觀賞點。匯演前，警方已實施特別交通安排，港鐵亦因配合人潮管制，暫時關閉部分車站出入口。
香港電台引述行政長官李家超表示，超過3萬枚煙花點亮維港夜空，匯演歷123分鐘。是次匯演慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年。
